user.title: Humidity Controller
user.description: One entry is one zone: a humidifier entity that keeps the humidity measured by your sensors by driving the selected devices. Device methods, presets and the failsafe are set afterwards under Configure.

init.title: Humidity Controller
init.description: Pick what to configure. Changes are saved only by «Save & exit».

sensors.title: Sensors & failsafe
sensors.description: Unavailable sensors are skipped; a tick is skipped only when all of them are out. If no sensor has a reading for longer than the timeout, the devices go to the failsafe state.

regulation.title: Hysteresis & on/off timing
regulation.description: For the «fan speed» and «on/off» methods: humidifying starts at target − hysteresis and stops at the target. A device is not switched again before the minimum on / off time has passed.

device.title: Device settings
device.description:
{device}

• Fan speed (default) — the controller sets how hard the device works: «manual» mode, the fan speed follows the humidity deficit (PI), the device is switched off at the target. The speed entity is taken from the same device (airmx: number.…_fan_speed) unless chosen below.
• Setpoint — the device stays in its own «auto» mode and gets the target shifted by (its own reading − the zone reading), limited to ± max correction.
• On/off — hysteresis only.
If the device lacks the mode a method needs (or no speed entity is found), it falls back to on/off.

presets.title: Presets & schedules
presets.description: Presets are the entity's modes. Each has a default humidity and an optional time-of-day schedule (linear between points, over midnight). Setting the humidity by hand switches the mode to «none».
